title: CopilotForge skill frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of every SKILL.md. Top-level keys follow the open Agent Skills format (name, description, license, metadata); the design brief's skill fields are carried inside metadata as plain comma-separated strings so that Copilot Cowork and other runtimes accept the file (decision D7).

lifecycle.description: Comma-separated subset of Discover, Envision, Mobilise, Enable, Deliver, Assure, Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve

maturity.description: Comma-separated maturity archetypes the skill mainly serves: explorer, adopter, builder, scaler, ai-enterprise

risk-tiers.description: Comma-separated progressive risk tiers (0-4) the skill's advice applies to

platforms.description: Comma-separated platform vocabulary ids, or platform-neutral

edition-support.description: Comma-separated subset of starter, scale, enterprise

reviewers.description: Comma-separated reviewer-class department ids whose gate applies, or none

sources.description: Comma-separated source record ids from sources/*.toml, or none
